notes.title: DEFINITIVE Definitive Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157239/c03148b93b507c5641dd9756758572cb301931b3.png[/img]

Sotidrokhima is my personal favorite among the games I've developed. And so, I saw fit - after some pondering - to give it one FINAL update which caps off its development for good.

This update is purely technical and brings:
[list]
[*]remastered musics
[*]visual improvements (added details; clipping textures fixed; etc.)
[*]reduced file size
[*][b]NOTE: [/b]old saves are now obsolete and will be deleted on launch.
[/list]

[b]THANK YOU [/b]for playing Sotidrokhima!

notes.title: DEFINITIVE Definitive Update (coming soon)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157239/6ce4568caa427b8d0a410ffaf3007c85c8e3040d.png[/img]

[i]Sotidrokhima[/i] is my first, and possibly last, game to receive this treatment; instead of development concluding along the Definitive Update, Sotidrokhima will get a [b]Definitive Definitive Update[/b] at some point in the (near) future.

Why:
[list]
[*]Because quite simply Sotidrokhima is my favorite from all the games I've developed as AcroGames.
[/list]
What it brings:
[list]
[*]audio improvement
[*]visual improvement
[*]technical improvement
[/list]

So while not necessarily bringing new content, it will allow for a more fluent gaming experience as you bash those invading Swedes to oblivion.

notes.title: --Definitive Update for Sotidrokhima has arrived!--
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release of the game's final update.
Player feedback has been taken into consideration while developing it, among other things.

The update includes:
[list]
[*]bug fixes
[*]quality-of-life upgrades
[*]new Renown-unlockable content
[*]more balanced difficulty
[*]NOTE: as with previous updates, old save files have been rendered obsolete and will be deleted upon first launch.
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 6
notes.content:
After yesterday's update, today we have the [b]Finnish Independence Day update![/b]

Small changes here and there:

[list]
[*]balanced enemy/ally character/player character melee reach again
[*]added hitpoints for ally characters to make them more durable in battles
[*]it is now possible to block Kaleva's projectiles in the final boss battle(s), just like any projectiles
[*]fixed audio bug related to the Kantele weapon
[*]NOTE: due to changes to saving, the existing saved game is rendered obsolete and will be deleted on first launch after updating.
[/list]
